entries.title: The Paid date shown on an expense line item now reads from the correct field
Attire has been added as a vendor type, covering suit rentals, dress sellers, tailors, and alterations
Vendor and guest Contact Log type dropdowns are now each alphabetized (Other pinned last)
RSVP status order updated to Pending, Invited, RSVP Yes, RSVP No, Maybe across all guest filters and status pickers
Gift types and prep categories are now alphabetized (Other pinned last)
Events can now have an optional logo, uploaded from a small control beside the SimchaKit brand in the sidebar
